company_name: Kunshan You Fu Precision Machine Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company manufactures equipment and components specifically for semiconductor assembly and testing processes.
summary: Kunshan You Fu Precision Machine Co., Ltd specializes in the development and manufacturing of precision equipment for the semiconductor industry, including wafer cassettes, frames, and various custom solutions. Their products are designed to support assembly and testing processes, catering to a range of clients in the semiconductor sector.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Kunshan city, Jiangsu province, focusing on serving customers in the China area.
